paragraphs.text: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
paragraphs.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν πνευματικῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Peri de tōn pneumatikōn, adelphoi, ou thelō hymas agnoein.

paragraphs.text: Ye know that when ye were Gentiles [ye were] led away unto those dumb idols, howsoever ye might led.
paragraphs.original: οἴδατε ὅτι ὅτε ἔθνη ἦτε πρὸς τὰ εἴδωλα τὰ ἄφωνα ὡς ἂν ἤγεσθε ἀπαγόμενοι.
paragraphs.translit: oidate hoti hote ethnē ēte pros ta eidōla ta aphōna hōs an ēgesthe apagomenoi.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore I make known unto you, that no man speaking in the Spirit of God saith, Jesus is anathema; and no man can say, Jesus is Lord, but in the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: διὸ γνωρίζω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἐν πνεύματι θεοῦ λαλῶν λέγει· Ἀνάθεμα Ἰησοῦς, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται εἰπεῖν· Κύριος Ἰησοῦς εἰ μὴ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: dio gnōrizō hymin hoti oudeis en pneumati theou lalōn legei· Anathema Iēsous, kai oudeis dynatai eipein· Kyrios Iēsous ei mē en pneumati hagiō.

paragraphs.text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
paragraphs.original: Διαιρέσεις δὲ χαρισμάτων εἰσίν, τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα·
paragraphs.translit: Diaireseis de charismatōn eisin, to de auto pneuma·

paragraphs.text: And there are diversities of ministrations, and the same Lord.
paragraphs.original: καὶ διαιρέσεις διακονιῶν εἰσιν, καὶ ὁ αὐτὸς κύριος·
paragraphs.translit: kai diaireseis diakoniōn eisin, kai ho autos kyrios·

paragraphs.text: And there are diversities of workings, but the same God, who worketh all things in all.
paragraphs.original: καὶ διαιρέσεις ἐνεργημάτων εἰσίν, ὁ δὲ αὐτὸς θεός, ὁ ἐνεργῶν τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai diaireseis energēmatōn eisin, ho de autos theos, ho energōn ta panta en pasin.

paragraphs.text: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit to profit withal.
paragraphs.original: ἑκάστῳ δὲ δίδοται ἡ φανέρωσις τοῦ πνεύματος πρὸς τὸ συμφέρον.
paragraphs.translit: hekastō de didotai hē phanerōsis tou pneumatos pros to sympheron.

paragraphs.text: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom; and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit:
paragraphs.original: ᾧ μὲν γὰρ διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος δίδοται λόγος σοφίας, ἄλλῳ δὲ λόγος γνώσεως κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα,
paragraphs.translit: hō men gar dia tou pneumatos didotai logos sophias, allō de logos gnōseōs kata to auto pneuma,

paragraphs.text: to another faith, in the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, in the one Spirit;
paragraphs.original: ἑτέρῳ πίστις ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ πνεύματι, ἄλλῳ χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ πνεύματι,
paragraphs.translit: heterō pistis en tō autō pneumati, allō charismata iamatōn en tō heni pneumati,

paragraphs.text: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits; to another [divers] kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues:
paragraphs.original: ἄλλῳ ἐνεργήματα δυνάμεων, ἄλλῳ προφητεία, 1ἄλλῳ διακρίσεις πνευμάτων, ἑτέρῳ γένη γλωσσῶν, 2ἄλλῳ ἑρμηνεία γλωσσῶν·
paragraphs.translit: allō energēmata dynameōn, allō prophēteia, 1allō diakriseis pneumatōn, heterō genē glōssōn, 2allō hermēneia glōssōn·

paragraphs.text: but all these worketh the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each one severally even as he will.
paragraphs.original: πάντα δὲ ταῦτα ἐνεργεῖ τὸ ἓν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα, διαιροῦν ἰδίᾳ ἑκάστῳ καθὼς βούλεται.
paragraphs.translit: panta de tauta energei to hen kai to auto pneuma, diairoun idia hekastō kathōs bouletai.

paragraphs.text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
paragraphs.original: Καθάπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα ἕν ἐστιν καὶ μέλη πολλὰ ἔχει, πάντα δὲ τὰ μέλη τοῦ σώματος πολλὰ ὄντα ἕν ἐστιν σῶμα, οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός·
paragraphs.translit: Kathaper gar to sōma hen estin kai melē polla echei, panta de ta melē tou sōmatos polla onta hen estin sōma, houtōs kai ho Christos·

paragraphs.text: For in one Spirit were we all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all made to drink of one Spirit.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ πνεύματι ἡμεῖς πάντες εἰς ἓν σῶμα ἐβαπτίσθημεν, εἴτε Ἰουδαῖοι εἴτε Ἕλληνες, εἴτε δοῦλοι εἴτε ἐλεύθεροι, καὶ πάντες ἓν πνεῦμα ἐποτίσθημεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar en heni pneumati hēmeis pantes eis hen sōma ebaptisthēmen, eite Ioudaioi eite Hellēnes, eite douloi eite eleutheroi, kai pantes hen pneuma epotisthēmen.

paragraphs.text: For the body is not one member, but many.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἓν μέλος ἀλλὰ πολλά.
paragraphs.translit: Kai gar to sōma ouk estin hen melos alla polla.

paragraphs.text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ πούς· Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ χείρ, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος;
paragraphs.translit: ean eipē ho pous· Hoti ouk eimi cheir, ouk eimi ek tou sōmatos, ou para touto ouk estin ek tou sōmatos;

paragraphs.text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν εἴπῃ τὸ οὖς· Ὅτι οὐκ εἰμὶ ὀφθαλμός, οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ σώματος, οὐ παρὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σώματος·
paragraphs.translit: kai ean eipē to ous· Hoti ouk eimi ophthalmos, ouk eimi ek tou sōmatos, ou para touto ouk estin ek tou sōmatos·

paragraphs.text: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
paragraphs.original: εἰ ὅλον τὸ σῶμα ὀφθαλμός, ποῦ ἡ ἀκοή; εἰ ὅλον ἀκοή, ποῦ ἡ ὄσφρησις;
paragraphs.translit: ei holon to sōma ophthalmos, pou hē akoē; ei holon akoē, pou hē osphrēsis;

paragraphs.text: But now hath God set the members each one of them in the body, even as it pleased him.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἔθετο τὰ μέλη, ἓν ἕκαστον αὐτῶν, ἐν τῷ σώματι καθὼς ἠθέλησεν.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de ho theos etheto ta melē, hen hekaston autōn, en tō sōmati kathōs ēthelēsen.

paragraphs.text: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
paragraphs.original: εἰ δὲ ἦν τὰ πάντα ἓν μέλος, ποῦ τὸ σῶμα;
paragraphs.translit: ei de ēn ta panta hen melos, pou to sōma;

paragraphs.text: But now they are many members, but one body.
paragraphs.original: νῦν δὲ πολλὰ μὲν μέλη, ἓν δὲ σῶμα.
paragraphs.translit: nyn de polla men melē, hen de sōma.

paragraphs.text: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of thee: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
paragraphs.original: οὐ δύναται δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμὸς εἰπεῖν τῇ χειρί· Χρείαν σου οὐκ ἔχω, ἢ πάλιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῖς ποσίν· Χρείαν ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔχω·
paragraphs.translit: ou dynatai de ho ophthalmos eipein tē cheiri· Chreian sou ouk echō, ē palin hē kephalē tois posin· Chreian hymōn ouk echō·

paragraphs.text: Nay, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be more feeble are necessary:
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ πολλῷ μᾶλλον τὰ δοκοῦντα μέλη τοῦ σώματος ἀσθενέστερα ὑπάρχειν ἀναγκαῖά ἐστιν,
paragraphs.translit: alla pollō mallon ta dokounta melē tou sōmatos asthenestera hyparchein anankaia estin,

paragraphs.text: and those [parts] of the body, which we think to be less honorable, upon these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἃ δοκοῦμεν ἀτιμότερα εἶναι τοῦ σώματος, τούτοις τιμὴν περισσοτέραν περιτίθεμεν, καὶ τὰ ἀσχήμονα ἡμῶν εὐσχημοσύνην περισσοτέραν ἔχει,
paragraphs.translit: kai ha dokoumen atimotera einai tou sōmatos, toutois timēn perissoteran peritithemen, kai ta aschēmona hēmōn euschēmosynēn perissoteran echei,

paragraphs.text: whereas our comely [parts] have no need: but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to that [part] which lacked;
paragraphs.original: τὰ δὲ εὐσχήμονα ἡμῶν οὐ χρείαν ἔχει. ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς συνεκέρασεν τὸ σῶμα, τῷ ὑστεροῦντι περισσοτέραν δοὺς τιμήν,
paragraphs.translit: ta de euschēmona hēmōn ou chreian echei. alla ho theos synekerasen to sōma, tō hysterounti perissoteran dous timēn,

paragraphs.text: that there should be no schism in the body; but [that] the members should have the same care one for another.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα μὴ ᾖ σχίσμα ἐν τῷ σώματι, ἀλλὰ τὸ αὐτὸ ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων μεριμνῶσι τὰ μέλη.
paragraphs.translit: hina mē ē schisma en tō sōmati, alla to auto hyper allēlōn merimnōsi ta melē.

paragraphs.text: And whether one member suffereth, all the members suffer with it; or [one] member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἴτε πάσχει ἓν μέλος, συμπάσχει πάντα τὰ μέλη· εἴτε δοξάζεται μέλος, συγχαίρει πάντα τὰ μέλη.
paragraphs.translit: kai eite paschei hen melos, sympaschei panta ta melē· eite doxazetai melos, synchairei panta ta melē.

paragraphs.text: Now ye are the body of Christ, and severally members thereof.
paragraphs.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε σῶμα Χριστοῦ καὶ μέλη ἐκ μέρους.
paragraphs.translit: Hymeis de este sōma Christou kai melē ek merous.

paragraphs.text: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, [divers] kinds of tongues.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὓς μὲν ἔθετο ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρῶτον ἀποστόλους, δεύτερον προφήτας, τρίτον διδασκάλους, ἔπειτα δυνάμεις, ἔπειτα χαρίσματα ἰαμάτων, ἀντιλήμψεις, κυβερνήσεις, γένη γλωσσῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hous men etheto ho theos en tē ekklēsia prōton apostolous, deuteron prophētas, triton didaskalous, epeita dynameis, epeita charismata iamatōn, antilēmpseis, kybernēseis, genē glōssōn.

paragraphs.text: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all [workers of] miracles?
paragraphs.original: μὴ πάντες ἀπόστολοι; μὴ πάντες προφῆται; μὴ πάντες διδάσκαλοι; μὴ πάντες δυνάμεις;
paragraphs.translit: mē pantes apostoloi; mē pantes prophētai; mē pantes didaskaloi; mē pantes dynameis;

paragraphs.text: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
paragraphs.original: μὴ πάντες χαρίσματα ἔχουσιν ἰαμάτων; μὴ πάντες γλώσσαις λαλοῦσιν; μὴ πάντες διερμηνεύουσιν;
paragraphs.translit: mē pantes charismata echousin iamatōn; mē pantes glōssais lalousin; mē pantes diermēneuousin;

paragraphs.text: But desire earnestly the greater gifts. And moreover a most excellent way show I unto you.
paragraphs.original: ζηλοῦτε δὲ τὰ χαρίσματα τὰ μείζονα. καὶ ἔτι καθʼ ὑπερβολὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῖν δείκνυμι.
paragraphs.translit: zēloute de ta charismata ta meizona. kai eti kathʼ hyperbolēn hodon hymin deiknymi.
